points.description: States one valid limitation of PVD, matching the model answer: the coating is thin in nature (thin deposited layer).
points.partial_credit: Vague statement, e.g. only 'coating problem' or 'not good coating', earns half.

points.description: States a second valid limitation from the model answer: complex shapes are difficult to coat, OR high cost, OR low output (low production rate).
points.partial_credit: Vague or partly correct statement, e.g. 'difficult to use' or 'costly equipment' without clear link, earns half.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for two distinct limitations from the model answer (thin coating, difficulty coating complex shapes, high cost, low output); synonyms are fine. Give 1 mark if only one correct limitation is given or if the limitations are stated vaguely. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated points, such as advantages of PVD. Do not count repeats of the same limitation twice.
